event_title: tracks at Avis crossing, near Windhoek
event_description: Thursday, 17 March 2011  THE force of gushing rivers and blocked storm water drains following this week’s torrential down pour caused walls to collapse and flooded several homes in Avis on Tuesday night stripping people of possessions and leaving them trembling with shock.  To add to their woes, a TransNamib train was also stopped in its tracks at the Avis crossing after a mudslide and rocks hit its side causing damage and preventing the locomotive from continuing its journey.
location_description: tracks at Avis crossing, near Windhoek
